title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 006
review_goal: Differentiate five MingCute book variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Open book outline from front with two page panels and a center line
items.context_bias: Use when the interface needs a straightforward front view of an open book.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for stacked books or a closed upright book when the visible pages need to stay open.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows the simplest front facing open book with straight page edges and a centered split.

items.depicts_observation: Upright closed book outline with a top label mark and thick bottom edge
items.context_bias: Use when the interface needs a single closed book shown upright instead of open pages.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the open book variants when the visible cover and page block matter.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot is the only selected book drawn as a standing closed volume with a label mark near the top.

items.depicts_observation: Two curved book outlines stacked opposite each other with mirrored page lines
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a paired stack of books rather than one open or closed volume.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for a single book when the icon visibly shows two separate curved book forms.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows two opposing book silhouettes stacked one above the other instead of one volume.

items.depicts_observation: Closed tilted book block with a small label mark on the top panel
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a single closed book shown in perspective with a visible top cover.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for upright or open books when the slanted perspective block is the key visual cue.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot uses a tilted perspective block with a top label mark rather than a front flat view.

items.depicts_observation: Three standing book blocks side by side with one panel leaning right
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants multiple books grouped together like a small shelf row.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for a single book when the image clearly shows three separate vertical volumes.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot is the only selected book variant that shows three upright volumes with one leaning.
